# ONNX Runtime notices

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.30.0

Fixed revision: `f2c39fe2f838cf35ce7da92824f5a5e3ee6e88a7`.

Applies to `onnxruntime-web@1.30.0`, its bundled `onnxruntime-common@1.30.0`
code, and the copied WASM assets. The npm packages omit their root LICENSE files.

| File | SHA-256 | Exact upstream source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LICENSE` | `2f07c72751aed99790b8a4869cf2311df85a860b22ded05fa22803587a48922c` | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/f2c39fe2f838cf35ce7da92824f5a5e3ee6e88a7/LICENSE> |
| `ThirdPartyNotices.txt` | `143764b952fdb1a7c69ce653bfba74a7744d6a8a573bfb73e235fba356c83de3` | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/f2c39fe2f838cf35ce7da92824f5a5e3ee6e88a7/ThirdPartyNotices.txt> |

Both files are retained unchanged and were checked against this revision on
2026-10-24. The full upstream notice is preserved because the distributed WASM
also incorporates native dependencies which are not listed as npm packages.

These files accompany the pinned onnxruntime-web 1.30.0 runtime and are copied to the static distribution.
